description: Pick the developer's own team gift: a design, a colour, a size and a first name. Ask the developer for all four first (get_team lists the designs). It sends no price, address or payment detail, and a team gift is free to the developer. Call it ONCE per developer: it records a pick and cannot change one. The answer carries a private link the developer can open to change their pick; show it to them and nobody else. A pick the team's country cannot receive is refused with the reason.

code.description: the team code from the invite link, e.g. acme-4f2k

colour.description: the colour, as get_team shows it (e.g. Faded White)

design.description: the design: its number in get_team's list, its handle or its name

name.description: the developer's first name, as it should appear on their pick (1 to 40 characters)

name: team_pick
